uses.title: 626 · Exchange seats
uses.snippet:
SELECT CASE WHEN id % 2 = 0 THEN id - 1
            WHEN id < (SELECT MAX(id) FROM Seat) THEN id + 1
            ELSE id END AS id, student
FROM Seat ORDER BY id;

uses.title: 176 · Second highest salary
uses.snippet: SELECT MAX(salary) AS SecondHighestSalary FROM Employee WHERE salary < (SELECT MAX(salary) FROM Employee);
